about.body:
Modern Engineering & Construction LLC is a construction consulting and labor supply firm — not a licensed contractor. We were founded in 2025 by industry veterans who understand what property owners and contractors actually need: unbiased guidance, competitive bids, and reliable people on the ground.

We build competitive bid packages for licensed trades, supply W-2 insured laborers to contractors and property owners, and provide independent consulting to GCs across Florida. Every project tracked through Projex.

process.heading:
How We
Work
process.intro: A transparent, structured process from first contact to project close — no surprises, no liability gaps.

steps.title: Scope & Assess
steps.desc: We evaluate your property, document existing conditions, and define the full scope of work before any contractor is engaged.

steps.title: Build Bid Package
steps.desc: We source 2–3 vetted, licensed contractors for your trade, write competitive scope documents, and collect qualified bids on your behalf.

steps.title: You Select & Hire
steps.desc: You review the options, compare pricing, and hire the contractor directly. We ensure all licenses and insurance are current before selection.

steps.title: We Manage & Track
steps.desc: We manage the project on your behalf — schedules, inspections, documentation — with full real-time visibility through Projex.

compare.heading:
The Old Way
vs. The Right Way
withoutItems: Hiring contractors without verifying license or insurance
Receiving a single bid with no competitive pressure
Liability exposure from uninsured or misclassified workers

No project tracking or closeout records
withItems: Every contractor in the bid is license-verified and insured
2–3 competitive bids on every scope — you control the selection
W-2 laborers under our GL & Workers’ Comp — zero liability transfer
Independent owner’s rep managing your project start to finish
Detailed scope docs reduce change orders before work begins
Full project history, reports, and closeout via Projex

items.title: W-2 Labor Supply

items.desc: We help licensed contractors win more work by developing detailed bid packages, pre-bid site documentation, and competitive scope breakdowns.

reach.body: From a single-family re-roof to a 50,000SF commercial membrane — our crews scale up or down to match your project without the overhead of keeping a full team on payroll.

reach.title: Your Schedule, Not Ours
reach.body: We integrate into your critical path from day one. Night work, weekends, phased rollouts, occupied facilities — we structure around your timeline, not the other way around.

reach.title: Fully Documented
reach.body: Daily reports, photo logs, as-built documentation, and closeout packages are standard on every scope — not upsells. Your clients get what they paid for, on paper.

services.heading:
Consulting, Bidding
& Labor Supply
services.text: Modern Engineering & Construction LLC is not a licensed contractor. We are a construction consulting and labor supply firm — we build bid packages, supply insured W-2 workers, and manage projects on your behalf.

items.title: Bid Packaging — Roofing
items.desc: For residential and commercial roofing needs, we develop a complete bid package — scope of work, material specifications, and 2–3 competitive proposals from vetted, licensed roofing contractors. You review the options and hire the contractor directly. We never hold or work under a roofing license.

items.title: Bid Packaging — All Trades
items.desc: We build bid packages for any licensed trade — electrical, plumbing, HVAC, structural, waterproofing, stucco, and more. Property owners and developers get competitive, documented options without having to source, vet, or negotiate with contractors themselves.

items.title: W-2 Labor Supply
items.desc: We employ field laborers as W-2 workers under our own General Liability and Workers’ Compensation insurance and make them available to licensed contractors, construction firms, and property owners. Our workers are our employees — your liability exposure is eliminated.

items.title: GC & Contractor Consulting
items.desc: We provide independent 1099 consulting services to licensed general contractors and specialty contractors — estimating, project coordination, scope writing, budget tracking, and schedule management. We bring the expertise without being on your license.

items.title: Project Management
items.desc: We manage construction projects on behalf of property owners — coordinating licensed trade contractors, tracking schedules, attending inspections, and delivering closeout documentation. We do not hold a contractor’s license and do not perform licensed work.

items.title: Contractor Vetting & Qualification
items.desc: Every contractor in a bid package is verified for active license status, current insurance certificates, BBB standing, and references. We eliminate unqualified bids before they reach you — you only see contractors who are legally able to perform the work.

items.title: Site Assessments & Reporting
items.desc: Pre-bid site assessments, drone surveys, condition reports, and documentation to define scope before contractors are engaged. We provide the documentation licensed contractors need to bid accurately — reducing change orders and scope disputes.

items.title: Insurance Claim Coordination
items.desc: We work with property owners and adjusters to define scope, organize licensed contractor bids, and coordinate the insurance claim process. We serve as the owner’s representative — not as a contractor — throughout the claim and repair process.
